metadata.updateSource: Jaskaran Singh Kandola, Co-Founder, Chief Information Officer and Information System Security Officer; scripts/platformone-package/build.ts
metadata.stateDescribed: Current state: ComplianceONE production in Microsoft Azure Government (US Gov Virginia) with the October 2026 gap-closure set.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: ComplianceONE is a multi-tenant governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform that federal agencies, their contractors and commercial organizations use to manage FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171/CMMC, GovRAMP, DoD Impact Level, TX-RAMP, ITAR and AS9100 programs. It holds control implementation records, policies, procedures, evidence files, POA&Ms, risks, incidents and assessment results; generates certification documents; reads security posture from customer-authorized integrations; and offers AI drafting assistance whose output a person reviews.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: PlatformOne's FedRAMP-compatible trust center for ComplianceONE (CDS-CSO-UTC): public certification data, the Certification Package for agencies, Ongoing Certification Reports, significant change notifications and the status page.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Public information is open. Agencies request access to the full Certification Package at https://www.complianceone.ai/trust or by email to security@platformoneinc.com; requests are decided within 1 business day (CDS-UTC-AGA).

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: The FedRAMP Certification Package: this overview, the Security Decision Record, Ongoing Certification Reports and their snapshots (CDS-CSO-HAD), and the rule artifacts. Human-readable and JSON.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Agencies and FedRAMP request access through the Trust Center or at security@platformoneinc.com. No NDA is required. Requests are decided within 1 business day; a denial is reported to FedRAMP within 5 business days (CDS-UTC-AAD).

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Every policy and procedure, with a human- and machine-readable index giving name, file, summary, word count, version, date and related FedRAMP practices (CDS-CSO-IRP).
Twelve months of Significant Change Notifications and evaluation records, human-readable and JSON (SCN-CSO-HIS, SCN-CSO-HRM).
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Public summary; full notifications and impact analyses are in the Certification Package.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Monthly human-readable vulnerability detection and response reports and the machine-readable history, updated at least every 14 days (VER-TFR-MHR, VER-TFR-MRH).

Current and 90-day historical availability of core services, including availability incidents, human- and machine-readable (CDS-CSO-AVR). Hosted apart from the production service, so it stays available when ComplianceONE is down.
Documentation of every programmatic endpoint for the certification data: the public JSON addresses, their formats and caching, and the token-based agency endpoints (CDS-TRC-PAC).

contactInformation.contactName: Jaskaran Singh Kandola, Co-Founder, Chief Information Officer and Information System Security Officer

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Framework catalogs (FedRAMP 20x and Rev5, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171/CMMC, GovRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, TX-RAMP, ITAR, AS9100), control implementation records, assignments, tailoring and common-control propagation.
Policy and procedure authoring, templates, review cycles and approvals.
Evidence files and references linked to controls, KSIs and requirements, stored in Azure Blob Storage.
Risk register, findings, POA&Ms, deviations and vulnerability detection and response records (PAIN, KEV, accepted vulnerabilities).
Gap and self-assessments, SSP and OSCAL exports, and the FedRAMP 20x package builders (CPO, SDR, OCR, SCN, incident and VER reports).
Read-only connections to customer-authorized security and IT tools that supply configuration and posture as evidence.
Customer-operated trust center and status page for publishing certification data.

certifiedServices.serviceName: Monitoring: incidents, vulnerabilities and CVE Hunter
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Incident records and FedRAMP incident reports, significant changes, compliance calendar, CVE hunter.
Drafts of statements, narratives and reports grounded in the tenant's own records, using Azure OpenAI Service in Azure Government; a person reviews each draft.

certified.useCase: Microsoft Azure Government (FedRAMP High): all compute, storage, database, networking, key management, Azure OpenAI, email (Azure Communication Services), security monitoring and backup for ComplianceONE.
Microsoft 365 GCC High: administrator identity lifecycle and the FedRAMP Security Inbox (security@platformoneinc.com). Holds no federal customer data.
GitHub Enterprise Cloud (FedRAMP Certified at Class B, Low; agency path): source code, code review, secret-scanning push protection and Dependabot. Holds no federal customer data.

nonCertified.name: Azure DevOps Services
nonCertified.useCase: Build, test, scan, sign and deploy pipelines; deploys only from the protected main branch. Holds no federal customer data. FedRAMP status: not listed in Microsoft's FedRAMP High audit scope for Azure or Azure Government (list updated September 2026); treated as a third party without a FedRAMP authorization.

nonCertified.name: Stripe
nonCertified.useCase: Subscription billing only: billing contacts and payment tokens. Receives no federal customer data; listed for transparency.
